description: Centralised online portal to lodge grievances against central and state government departments.
eligibility: Any citizen with a complaint about a government service.
benefits: Complaint gets a registration number and can be tracked online; the department must respond within the prescribed time.
documents_required: Basic identity and contact details, description of the issue, supporting documents.
how_to_apply: Register the grievance at the CPGRAMS portal and track it using the registration number.

description: Law that lets citizens request information from public authorities.
benefits: Application fee of Rs 10 for central public authorities; the authority must generally reply within 30 days.
documents_required: Written application or online application with the fee.
how_to_apply: File online on the RTI Online portal for central ministries or to the Public Information Officer of the department.
